```{r}
paths <- list.files(
  file.path(reports_path, "raisd"),
  pattern = "\\.clean\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

df <- rbindlist(lapply(paths, function(p) {
  fname <- basename(p)
  
  pop <- sub("^RAiSD_Report\\.wm_", "", fname)
  pop <- sub("\\.clean\\.tsv$", "", pop)
  
  cbind(
    pop = pop,
    fread(p, col.names = c(
      "chr",
      "position",
      "win_start",
      "win_end",
      "VAR",
      "SFS",
      "LD",
      "mu"
    ))
  )
}))

# ── Filtering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. Remove first 200 kb (telomere artifact)
# 2. Compute SNP-density proxy: VAR / window span
# 3. Remove lowest 5% of SNP-density windows (global cutoff across all pops)

DENSITY_CUTOFF <- 0.05

df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(position >= 200000) %>%
  mutate(
    win_span = win_end - win_start,
    snp_density = VAR / win_span
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    density_cutoff = quantile(snp_density, DENSITY_CUTOFF, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(snp_density >= density_cutoff) %>%
  select(-density_cutoff)

# ── Summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Windows removed:", nrow(df) - nrow(df_filtered), "\n")

# Optional sanity check
df %>%
  group_by(pop) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_VAR = mean(VAR, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_span = mean(win_end - win_start, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_density = mean(VAR / (win_end - win_start), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VAR)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_wrap(~ pop, scales = "free_y")

```

```{r}
# order chromosomes once, globally
chr_levels <- df_filtered %>%
  distinct(chr) %>%
  mutate(chr_num = as.numeric(str_extract(chr, "\\d+"))) %>%
  arrange(chr_num, chr) %>%
  pull(chr)

prep_raisd <- function(dat) {
  dat <- dat %>%
    mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = chr_levels)) %>%
    group_by(chr) %>%
    mutate(chr_start = min(position),
           chr_end   = max(position)) %>%
    ungroup()

  chr_df <- dat %>%
    distinct(chr, chr_start, chr_end) %>%
    arrange(chr) %>%
    mutate(chr_len = chr_end - chr_start,
           offset  = lag(cumsum(chr_len + 1), default = 0),
           center  = offset + chr_len / 2)

  dat %>%
    left_join(chr_df %>% select(chr, offset), by = "chr") %>%
    mutate(genome_pos = position - chr_start + offset) %>%
    list(data = ., axisdf = chr_df)
}

plot_raisd_pop <- function(dat, pop_name) {
  prep <- prep_raisd(dat)
  d <- prep$data
  axisdf <- prep$axisdf

  ggplot(d, aes(x = genome_pos, y = VAR, col = chr)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = axisdf$center,
      labels = gsub("chr", "", axisdf$chr),
      expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("#2C3E50", "#95A5A6"), length.out = nrow(axisdf))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      text = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 16),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "\nChromosome",
      y = "μ_VAR\n",
      title = paste("RAiSD:", pop_name)
    )
}

plots <- lapply(split(df_filtered, df_filtered$pop), function(d) {
  plot_raisd_pop(d, unique(d$pop))
})

ggsave(
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1),
  filename = file.path(figures_path, "raisd", "raisd_plot.png"),
  height = 8,
  width = 16
)
```
